info.title: AxioDB Dashboard HTTP API (Control Server)
info.description:
REST API behind the AxioDB Dashboard - the web GUI AxioDB starts on port 27018 - for managing databases, collections, indexes, documents, users, and roles.

This is not a hosted service. It runs inside your own AxioDB process: enable it with `new AxioDB({ GUI: true })`, or with `AXIODB_GUI=true` on the `theankansaha/axiodb` Docker image. https://axiodb.in serves documentation only.

This API is one of several AxioDB surfaces and is not interchangeable with the others:
- Embedded library (`npm install axiodb`) - in-process, no HTTP at all. https://axiodb.in/api-reference
- AxioDBCloud TCP server/client on port 27019 - its own wire protocol, not HTTP. https://axiodb.in/cloud
- MCP server on port 27020 (Docker image only) - Streamable HTTP at /mcp, 43 tools. https://axiodb.in/mcp-server

The Dashboard, AxioDBCloud authentication, and the MCP server share one user and role store.

Human-readable reference: https://axiodb.in/server-api

get.description: Retrieves system information including package name, version, author details, and license information.
Liveness probe. Unauthenticated, and deliberately minimal - it is what the Docker healthcheck calls. Host details live on /api/system instead.

get.summary: Operational detail for the Status page: process, memory, cache, instance and service ports
get.description: Operational detail for the Status page: process, memory, cache, instance and service ports. Requires authentication and the dashboard:view permission, because it reports host characteristics that should not be exposed anonymously.

get.summary: Returns a list of all available API routes and their descriptions
get.description: Returns a list of all available API routes and their descriptions. Useful for API discovery.

get.description: Retrieves dashboard statistics including total databases, collections, documents, and storage usage. Perfect for admin dashboards.

post.summary: Authenticates with username/password and starts a server-side session, returning the session as an httpOnly cookie
post.description: Authenticates with username/password and starts a server-side session, returning the session as an httpOnly cookie. On first login (including the seeded default admin), the response signals that a password change is required before any other action is allowed.

200.description: Success - Login successful, session cookie set

400.description: Bad Request - Missing username or password

post.summary: Revokes the current session (server-side) and clears the session cookie.
post.description: Revokes the current session (server-side) and clears the session cookie.

get.summary: Returns the currently authenticated user's username, role, resolved permissions, and whether a password change is still required
get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's username, role, resolved permissions, and whether a password change is still required. This is the endpoint the GUI calls on load to restore session state.

patch.description: Changes the caller's own password. Requires the current password. Rotates the session, so any previously issued cookie for this account becomes invalid.

400.description: Bad Request - Wrong current password or weak new password

get.summary: Lists all users (Super Admin only - requires the `user:view` permission)
get.description: Lists all users (Super Admin only - requires the `user:view` permission). Password hashes are never included in the response.

post.summary: Creates a new user with a temporary password and an assigned role (Super Admin only - requires `user:create`)
post.description: Creates a new user with a temporary password and an assigned role (Super Admin only - requires `user:create`). The new user is forced to change their password on first login.

role.description: One of the existing role names

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid username/password or unknown role

patch.summary: Changes a user's assigned role (Super Admin only - requires `user:update-role`)
patch.description: Changes a user's assigned role (Super Admin only - requires `user:update-role`). Revokes that user's existing sessions immediately.

200.description: Success - Role updated, target user's sessions revoked

400.description: Bad Request - Unknown role, user not found, or would remove the last Super Admin

patch.summary: Admin-forced password reset (Super Admin only - requires `user:reset-password`)
patch.description: Admin-forced password reset (Super Admin only - requires `user:reset-password`). Sets a new password and flags the account to require a password change on next login. Revokes that user's existing sessions immediately.

200.description: Success - Password reset, target user's sessions revoked

400.description: Bad Request - User not found or weak password

delete.summary: Deletes a user (Super Admin only - requires `user:delete`)
delete.description: Deletes a user (Super Admin only - requires `user:delete`). Rejected if the target is the last remaining Super Admin account.

400.description: Bad Request - User not found or is the last remaining Super Admin

get.summary: Lists all roles, including custom roles created from the permission catalogue (Super Admin only - requires `role:view`).
get.description: Lists all roles, including custom roles created from the permission catalogue (Super Admin only - requires `role:view`).

post.summary: Creates a new role from the predefined permission catalogue (Super Admin only - requires `role:create`)
post.description: Creates a new role from the predefined permission catalogue (Super Admin only - requires `role:create`). Every permission key must exist in the catalogue returned by GET /api/auth/roles/permissions.

roleName.description: Unique name for the new role

permissions.description: Array of permission keys from the catalogue

400.description: Bad Request - Unknown permission key(s)

delete.description: Deletes a custom role. Predefined roles and roles assigned to users cannot be deleted.

400.description: Bad Request - System role, assigned role, or role not found

get.summary: Returns the full predefined permission catalogue, grouped by category - used to render the permission picker when creating a custom role.
get.description: Returns the full predefined permission catalogue, grouped by category - used to render the permission picker when creating a custom role.

data.description: View the list of databases and dashboard database counts

get.description: Retrieves a list of all databases in the AxioDB instance with their metadata, including size, path, and creation date.

post.summary: Creates a new database with the specified name
post.description: Creates a new database with the specified name. Database names must be unique and follow naming conventions (alphanumeric and underscores).

name.description: The name of the database to create

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid database name or name is missing

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to create database

delete.summary: Permanently deletes a database and all its collections
delete.description: Permanently deletes a database and all its collections. This operation cannot be undone. Use with extreme caution in production.

parameters.name: dbName
parameters.description: The name of the database to delete

404.description: Not Found - Database does not exist

500.description: Internal Server Error - Failed to delete database

get.summary: Exports a database as a compressed .tar.gz file for backup or migration
get.description: Exports a database as a compressed .tar.gz file for backup or migration. The file is streamed to the client as a downloadable attachment.

parameters.name: dbName
parameters.description: The name of the database to export

200.description: Success - Database exported as tar.gz file

400.description: Bad Request - Database name is required

404.description: Not Found - Database does not exist

post.summary: Imports a database from a .tar.gz produced by Export
post.description: Imports a database from a .tar.gz produced by Export. The upload is staged outside the data directory and validated as a genuine AxioDB export before anything is promoted into place, so a rejected archive leaves nothing behind. The database name is read from the archive's contents, not its filename. Concurrent imports of different databases run in parallel; two imports of the same database conflict and the second is refused.

file.description: The .tar.gz file containing the database to import

400.description: Bad Request - No file, unreadable archive, not an AxioDB export, or an archive that expands past the 100:1 ratio limit

403.description: Forbidden - The archive holds a reserved system database

409.description: Conflict - That database already exists, or is being imported by someone else right now

413.description: Payload Too Large - The upload was truncated before it finished

get.description: Returns the total number of documents in one collection.

400.description: Bad Request - Database and collection are required

get.description: Retrieves all documents from a collection with pagination support. Returns 10 documents per page, sorted by most recent updates first.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters

post.description: Retrieves documents matching a MongoDB-style query with pagination. Supports operators like $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $ne, $in, $regex. Optionally pass a hint to force a specific index.

parameters.description: Index field name to force (e.g. 'email' to use the email index)

get.description: Retrieves a specific document by its unique documentId. Fastest way to fetch a single document.

post.description: Retrieves multiple documents by their IDs in a single call. More efficient than multiple by-id requests.
